artworks.title: Heroic Act of a Father Who Sacrifices for  His Son (Trait heroique d'un pere qui se sacrifie pour son fils)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a large tree. The image features a central large tree with dense foliage, around which several figures are gathered. The style is detailed with fine line work that creates the texture of the tree's bark and the leaves. The figures around the tree appear to be engaged in various activities. Numerous lines and shading techniques are used to give depth and texture to different elements, such as the ground and the figures.

artworks.title: At La Gaiete Rochechouart: Nicolle (A La Gaieté Rochechouart: Nicolle)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person who is facing forward, with their hands possibly resting in the pockets of their dark garment. The person is standing upright. They have distinctive facial features, with a prominent elongated nose and a slight smile. The hair is styled in an unusual way, with a high bun or curl on top. They are wearing a high-collared, dark outfit that contrasts with the pale background. In the background, there are sketch-like, vertical lines and an arch-like structure to the left, done in a soft, blurred manner.

artworks.title: In the Woods (Au bois)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image captures a woman walking to the right side of the frame. She is wearing a large hat, a light-colored dress with puffy sleeves extending to her feet, dark gloves and shoes. She is holding a leash attached to a small dog walking ahead of her. In the background, there is a figure on horseback against a minimalistic landscape.

artworks.title: At the Concert (Au concert)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two people seated, possibly in a theater setting. The woman is on the left, facing away with a composed expression. She wears a dark hat with feathers, a textured wrap, and light-colored hair. The man on the right has sharp facial features, a top hat, suit, bow tie, and floral lapel decoration. The background is a warm, textured red, with a diagonal line hinting at a theater box.

artworks.title: At the Hanneton (Au Hanneton)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: An illustration of a person seated at a table is shown. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with both arms resting on the table. The person's facial features are lightly sketched, with discernible eyes and a mouth, and the person is wearing an elaborate hat. The clothing appears layered and possibly ruffled. On the table are a bottle, a mug, and a small rectangular object. The background features a tufted booth and a curtain or wall partition. The sketching style is loose and impressionistic, with muted tones.

artworks.title: Brandes in His Box (Brandès dans sa loge)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two people. One person is seated, visible from the shoulders up, with one hand resting at their chin. Their head is turned slightly to their left, with facial features including a prominent nose, closed eyes, and thick upward-styled hair. They are wearing a garment with wavy patterns, and a portion of their sleeve is detailed. In the background, to their left, is a standing figure shown from just above the knees up. This person has a rounded face with glasses, short hair, and appears to be wearing a jacket. The background has a lightly textured, speckled detailing.

artworks.title: Woman in Corset (Femme en corset)
artworks.description: The image portrays a woman and a man within an interior setting. The woman is seen from the waist up, viewed from behind, adjusting her dress while looking at a mirror. She is wearing a long white dress with a black corset and a yellow sash around her waist, with her hair styled in a bun. The man is seated beside her, wearing a top hat and a monochrome suit, gazing in her direction. The room features a carpet with patterns and a framed artwork on the wall, indicating a well-furnished setting.

artworks.title: Woman Combing Her Hair (Femme qui se peigne)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body from behind in a seated position. The individual is leaning forward with their left arm raised over the head, combing their hair. They have dark hair cascading down their back. Their right arm is bent at the elbow and holds a comb. The person is wearing a loosely fitting garment that slides off one shoulder, revealing the curve of the shoulder and back. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects aside from the comb. The background shows indistinct shapes that may suggest a domestic interior setting.

artworks.title: Woman on Her Back (Femme sur le dos)
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person reclining on a bed. The person is lying on their back with one knee bent and arms behind their head. The face is softly sketched with suggested closed eyes and loose hair. The person is partially covered by a blanket or sheet. The setting appears to be a bedroom with simple elements in the background. The sketch is in a muted tone with reddish-brown lines on a neutral background.

artworks.title: Footit and Chocolat (Footit et Chocolat)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures and a horse. The illustration shows a dynamic scene with abstract figures in the background. In the foreground, a figure in a dynamic pose is depicted, wearing traditional or elaborate attire. To the right, the back legs of a horse are visible, suggesting motion. The lines are sparse and sketch-like, creating a sense of movement and immediacy, with some areas intentionally vague for energy and spontaneity.

artworks.title: The Manor Lady or the Omen (La chatelaine ou le tocsin)
artworks.medium: lithograph in turquoise and light blue [poster]
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in the foreground. The person is facing slightly to the right with relaxed arms by their sides. They have delicate facial features, defined contours, and medium-length wavy or loosely curled hair. They are wearing a long, flowing dress with puffed sleeves. In the background, there are slender, tall trees and an animal resembling a wolf or dog near the person. A castle-like structure with pointed towers and a turreted roof is visible behind them, along with a crescent moon in the sky. Lines of trees or shrubs in the distance complete the scene.

artworks.title: The Motorist (L'automobiliste)
artworks.description: This is a print of a man in a fuzzy fur coat driving a car. The man is on the left side of the print, and he has dark skin, a mustache that curves upwards, high cheekbones, and a long nose. His lips are closed in a neutral expression. He wears a flat black hat and round glasses. His left hand holds a black lever, and his right hand is in a fist on top of a small, horizontal wheel. In front of him is a flat surface, and from behind him, dark smoke billows into the air. In the background, there is a faint sketch of a standing person in a dress and a small dog. The background of the print is tan, yellowish paper.

artworks.title: La Goulue
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man and a woman dancing. The woman has her hair in an updo, wears a blouse with puffed sleeves, and has one arm around the man's shoulder. The man is taller, wearing a top hat and a suit, with one arm raised in a dancing pose. The background has sketchy outlines of other figures, possibly dancers or an audience. The artwork uses minimal color, focusing on line and shading for form and movement.

artworks.title: The Forfeit (La gage)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on hand-made paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in an interior setting. One figure is seated and two are standing. The figures are sketched with light pencil strokes. The seated figure has detailed clothing, while the standing figures appear to be in conversation. In the background, there is a picture or sculpture of a horse and rider. The drawing style is suggestive of casual observation, capturing a moment in time with swift and expressive lines.

artworks.title: Leloir and Moreno in "Les femmes savantes" (Leloir et Moreno dans "Les femmes savantes")
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the upper body up. One person is seated in a large armchair, leaning back with their head slightly tilted and legs crossed. This person has curly hair, a prominent nose, and is wearing a dark garment with ruffled cuffs, holding a letter. The other individual is shown as an outline standing or sitting beside the first person, facing forward. They have curly hair and delicate facial features. In the background, there is a framed portrait of a third person with long hair and a serious expression, and the walls are sketched with light lines and patterns.

artworks.title: Bust of Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender (Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender, en buste)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in olive green on Japan paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched portrait of a person's upper body in a side profile. The person has their head slightly turned downward and to the side, with detailed facial features including the nose, lips, eyes, and hair pulled up. The person appears to be resting their chin or cheek against a surface or hand. They are depicted wearing clothing with a high ruffled collar and a textured bodice, possibly with lace. In the background, there is a frame enclosing the sketch and a circular emblem or monogram. There are no other discernible objects in the image.

artworks.title: Miss Loïe Fuller
artworks.artist: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (artist); André Marty (publisher); Edouard Ancourt (printer)
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract shape with fluid curves and soft outlines. The central figure has a mix of colors, including red, yellow, and blue. The background is dark with mottled brown areas that fade into lighter shades.

artworks.title: Ornament with Morris Dancers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with fantastical elements surrounded by ornate foliage. The composition is a black and white engraving, featuring swirling vine-like details. At its center is a standing figure in flowing robes and a tall headdress, surrounded by smaller figures in dynamic poses. The background is filled with ornamental foliage patterns, creating a sense of movement. The drawing is in the style of Martin Schongauer, known for detailed engravings blending human figures with vegetal ornamentation.

artworks.title: Carabinier Mounting a Horse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier with a horse. The drawing shows a soldier wearing a plumed helmet, preparing to mount a horse. The horse is adorned with a bridle and saddle, indicating its readiness for riding. In the background, there is a stone structure resembling a fort or wall, with additional riders seen leading other horses and carrying lances. The scene suggests a military or cavalry context. The drawing includes delicate details in the shading and form that capture the musculature of the horse and the texture of the soldier's uniform, illustrating an intricate, realistic style characteristic of detailed draughtsmanship.

artworks.title: French Race Horses
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of horses racing with a hot air balloon and trees in the background. The image shows several horses galloping across a dirt track. There is a hot air balloon in the sky, set against a backdrop of green trees. Tricolor flags are visible in the scene.

artworks.title: Gellius de Bouma
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an elderly man who is seated. He is facing the viewer, with distinct facial features including a long, full white beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and a broad forehead. He is wearing a high-collared garment with elaborate detailing, and a rich, heavy robe draped over one shoulder. His hands are visible, one resting on his lap and the other's thumb visible over a piece of draped fabric. There is a table beside him with several books and a writing quill. The background is a textured, dark surface.

artworks.title: Nieuwmarkt with St. Anthoniswaag (S. Anthoni s Marckt met de Waegh)
artworks.description: The image shows a historical structure known as S. Anthonis Marckt met de Waagh across a body of water. The structure is situated above the center of the image, surrounded by trees and other buildings. Smoke is seen coming from chimneys in the background. The artwork displays fine-lined etching techniques, creating a detailed and textured appearance with a monochromatic color palette. Two boats are docked near a wooden quay, and figures are depicted near a small platform. Trees line the scene on either side, extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Eenhoorns Sluis (De Eenhoorns Sluys)
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge with a canal lock spanning across a body of water. Numerous mast of docked ships are visible in the distance, and trees line the scene on either side of the bridge. On the right side of the image, there are tall buildings with architectural details typical of the period. The image is a detailed etching, with fine lines and cross-hatching techniques used throughout. The palette is monochromatic, and various tones depict different elements in the scene. There are small boats moored along the water's edge, with figures engaged in activities.

artworks.title: Noordenmarkt with the Noorden Kerk (De Noorder Marckt met de Kerck)
artworks.description: The image shows a canal lined with buildings and a detailed church tower on the left. Trees are on both sides of the canal, boats are docked on the right, and a market scene is visible on the bank. A small bridge arches over the canal in the center. The horizon is low, with the church tower and tree tops breaking the skyline. The print is created using delicate etching techniques, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white creating depth and texture.
